items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: Ernest Rapinoe on snare drum... Babe, Babe Risley always was managing.

ctx.x: But before that, Babe, Babe Risley always was managing. Babe, Babe Risley had Peter Borkard, no, and P-Rone on violin. I think, I know P-Rone was on violin. T-O on clanging, Risley on trombone, Celeste on conant, I think it's George Foster on bass, Ernest Rapinoe on snare drum. And who was playing piano at that time? I think it was Freddie, no, Freddie wasn't playing. Freddie was playing by himself all the time.
